groups.label: A new lad again at sixty-eight, with everything to prove
groups.description: To the old hands at the gate, by work they can see, and to a body that felt ninety after two hours

groups.label: Surplus since retiring: torn between being needed and left be
groups.description: Shut in, in Pat's way and needed by nothing, and glad of a plot that asks nothing of him

groups.label: From at a loss before the brambles to proud of a cleared square
groups.description: Not knowing where to start, then a square three yards by three looked at like a rebuilt bus

groups.label: Watched at the gate, and showing the old hands by work
groups.description: Silence at the gate, a place earned and never asked for, and a modest hope to be one of them

groups.label: Frightened to find out what his body has left
groups.description: Felt ninety after two hours, and a year in a chair that took something from him

quoted.T1:3:0: "And they all stopped talking. … I felt like the new lad on his first day at the depot."
quoted.T1:9:0: "I'm in the way of the hoover. … Everything works without it. That's what retiring's been. I'm the part left over."
quoted.T1:35:0: "Just looked at my square. You'd laugh. Three yards by three, and I stood there looking at it like it was a bus I'd rebuilt."
